modules.name: Learn
modules.title: Tag Formation Rules
modules.instructions: Master how to form question tags with auxiliary verbs, modals, and do/does/did. Understand positive/negative patterns and special cases like 'aren't I?' and 'shall we?'.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Tag Practice
modules.instructions: Write sentences with correct question tags for agreement, confirmation, and polite requests. Apply intonation awareness in written form.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Tag Matching Games
modules.instructions: Match statements to correct question tags. Practice recognizing auxiliary verbs and polarity reversal.

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Tag Vocabulary Challenge
modules.instructions: Spell and use key terms: auxiliary, modal, polarity, intonation, confirmation, agreement.
